summary: @servicetitan/anvil2 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes opaque obfuscated bundle
details: The package's preinstall script setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) from GitHub, extracts and chmods the binary, then uses it via execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js in the package directory. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a shuffled string/number lookup table and a rotation decoder — no reviewable source. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style transformations (`_0xNNNN` identifiers, junk-property wrapper objects around fs/https/execFileSync calls). The package is advertised as a React UI component library and its dist/ tree contains ordinary component code; there is no legitimate reason for a UI library's install hook to fetch an alternate runtime and execute an opaque bundle under a math-themed filename. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` and runs arbitrary code on the installer's machine under Bun, bypassing Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
